leadership.title: Lead Volunteer Coordinator
leadership.organization: Natchathiravila · Canadian Tamil Radio Annual Concert
details: Directed 40+ volunteers across stage operations, logistics, and technical coordination.
Maintained safety and communication standards throughout multi-day cultural events.
Acted as liaison between management, vendors, and volunteers.
Recognised for organisational reliability under time-sensitive conditions.

leadership.title: Co-President
leadership.organization: Wellness Warriors Club · Westhill Collegiate Institute
details: Organised mental health campaigns and school-wide “Wellness Wednesdays” discussions.
Oversaw team scheduling, outreach, and inter-grade collaboration.
Developed communication initiatives promoting mindfulness and stress awareness.
Strengthened leadership and coordination in a student-led environment.

leadership.title: Peer Tutor & STEM+ Club Member
leadership.description: STEM tutoring, hands-on activities, and showcase support.
details: Tutored over 60 hours in physics, chemistry, and mathematics, improving student academic performance.
Produced summary sheets and practice materials adopted by peers.
Guided small groups through hands-on STEM challenges and demonstrations.
Supported STEM showcase logistics and presentation coaching for junior students.

leadership.title: Assistant Admin / Coach-in-training
leadership.description: Youth programme administration and coaching support.
details: Managed scheduling, attendance, and inventory for youth basketball camps across multiple sites.
Assisted coaching staff with training, gameplay supervision, and youth mentorship.
Created tracking tools, improving resource management and participant engagement.
Ensured coordination between coaches, parents, and programme administration.

leadership.title: Yoga Trainee Instructor

details: Completed foundational training of “Yogaratna” teaching level.
Supported mixed-level sessions emphasising accessibility and physical safety.
Helped organise community yoga events promoting wellness engagement.
Strengthened composure and instructional communication in group settings.
